# Authplane

> Self-hosted OAuth 2.1 + Model Context Protocol (spec 2025-11-25) authorization server delivered as a single Go binary. Use it to add MCP-spec-compliant authorization to an MCP server, federate to an existing IdP, broker upstream provider OAuth (GitHub, Slack, Google, Linear, ...), and record agent-on-behalf-of-user delegation chains. AGPL-3.0.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention so AI agents can navigate the project without a clone. The deterministic workflow for adding Authplane to an existing MCP server lives in `AGENTS.md`; everything below is the link map.

## Start here

- [Root README](README.md): product pitch, SDK matrix, status & roadmap, RFC inventory.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): deterministic workflow for AI coding agents — SDK pins per stack, three byte-for-byte rules, retrofit recipe.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): persona-shaped entry points (Evaluator / Builder / Operator / Architect / Contributor).

## Retrofit an existing MCP server (highest-leverage path)

- [Go retrofit](examples/go/retrofit-existing-mcp-server/): before/after diff, runnable.
- [TypeScript retrofit](examples/typescript/retrofit-existing-mcp-server/): before/after diff, runnable.
- [Python retrofit](examples/python/retrofit-existing-mcp-server/): before/after diff, runnable.

## SDK packages (pin these by stack)

- Go: `github.com/authplane/go-sdk` ([repo](https://github.com/authplane/go-sdk)) — core + MCP-SDK adapter + FastMCP adapter.
- TypeScript: `@authplane/sdk`, `@authplane/mcp`, `@authplane/fastmcp` (npm) — ESM-only, Node.js 22+.
- Python: `authplane`, `authplane-mcp`, `authplane-fastmcp` (PyPI) — requires Python 3.12+.

## Tiered runnable examples (Go · TypeScript · Python)

- Tier 01 — basic MCP server: [Go](examples/go/01-mcp-server-basic/) · [TypeScript](examples/typescript/01-mcp-server-basic/) · [Python](examples/python/01-mcp-server-basic/)
- Tier 02 — agent calling an MCP server: [Go](examples/go/02-agent-basic/) · [TypeScript](examples/typescript/02-agent-basic/) · [Python](examples/python/02-agent-basic/)
- Tier 03 — DPoP + per-tool scopes: [Go](examples/go/03-mcp-server-dpop-scopes/) · [TypeScript](examples/typescript/03-mcp-server-fastmcp-dpop/) · [Python](examples/python/03-mcp-server-dpop-scopes/)
- Tier 04 — broker upstream + RFC 8693 token exchange: [Go](examples/go/04-broker-upstream/) · [TypeScript](examples/typescript/04-broker-upstream/) · [Python](examples/python/04-broker-upstream/)
